entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: A warrior and powerful mage of Kusho on Dominaria, around whom the islanders gathered in times of crisis.

entities.name: Kusho

events.summary: Gosta defends his family when pirates attack his shores.
events.quote: Gosta was the valiant defender of his family when pirates attacked his shores.

events.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War, Gosta leads Kusho as its most powerful mage, allied with Kasimir.

events.summary: With help from Ayesha Tanaka and Lord Magnus, Kusho is liberated and cleansed.
